scenario_text: At a locus maintained by balancing selection, the heterozygote has the highest fitness while both homozygotes are less fit. This overdominance drives the allele frequency toward a stable interior equilibrium determined by the two homozygote selection coefficients. We consider the equilibrium allele frequency reached under such heterozygote advantage. The target is the equilibrium frequency as a function of the selection coefficients against the two homozygotes.
